[SWS_PER_00524]
⌈
ara::per::ReadAccessor::ReadLine shall read all char-
acters until the delimiter (defaulting to the newline character) or the end of the file
is reached, and return them as a ara::core::String. The delimiter shall not be
included in the returned ara::core::String. The position shall be set to the char-
acter following the delimiter or the end of the file.
⌋
